title: Three.js
summary: 3D as a sunlit paper tabletop: matte pastel forms under soft daylight with blurred contact shadows on the theme’s mint-cream paper — pebbles, an arch still life, photo prints, ribbons, petals, a sunrise and a soft bar chart. Everything glides into place and keeps drifting.
